data.name: CAT BURGLARS™
data.detailed_description:
CATS ARE SPIES.
You and up to nine other players (wow!) are cats mobilizing their cuteness against the enemy! Infiltrate deadly enemy bases, map them out, find their goodies, and complete top-secret missions for huge payouts. They'll never see it coming!

PULL OFF DARING HEISTS
See some valuables? They have your name on them! Find high-security vaults hidden deep within facilities. If you can crack them open, the rewards are yours for the taking! Will you walk out triumphantly without leaving a trace, or with the enemy in hot pursuit as you make your daring escape?

HIGH-TECH CAT ESPIONAGE
These felines come backed by the world's deepest pockets and armed with the world's best tech! Utilize an arsenal of spy gear and disguises to scout facilities, bypass security, and turn situations on their head.

STEALTH IS OPTIONAL. CHAOS IS INEVITABLE.
Destruction, mayhem, carnage... there's only consequences if they catch you! So break down that door, fry that laser grid, and crash that vehicle - who knows, maybe chaos will cover your tracks better than secrecy!

BUILD YOUR SPY-CAT COLLECTIVE
Use your amassing riches to build up the world's greatest spy collective! Unlock new characters from a massive roster as you expand your headquarters to house your new friends.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 390
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
